# Hi-tech 190 (plugins)

Ficha do template `hitech-plugins` (versão 1). Estilo: Hi-tech.

The MIDI of 'Hi-tech 190 (from Wake Up and Remember)' with its old sounds and effects reset: kick, KBBB bass in A, hats, percussion, crashes, lead, FM answer and arp over 296 bars at 190 BPM (intro 8, breaks of 8 and 16). Kick, Accents, Impacts: sfizz (FreePats GM, note 36) until Kick 3 is activated. Bass, Lead, FM answer, Arp: Serum 2. Space and Huge buses: Pro-R 2; Echo bus: Timeless 3 (100% wet). Master: Pro-Q 4, Pro-L 2. Hats, Percussion and Crash: sfizz with the FreePats GM kit (crash on 49, percussion on claves 75 and cabasa 69). Choose the presets, then save it as your own template.

Feito a partir de "hitech-ref", do tick 0 ao 0 (compassos 1.1 a 1.1).
